videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

'Pass, pass, slow, slow' - Man City's slick machine grinding to a halt.
Manchester City's slick footballing machine is starting to grind to a halt, as displayed in their laborious Champions League draw against Napoli.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Pochettino leads Man Utd fury at Yoro red card ruling.
Manchester United and Mauricio Pochettino are furious at how Leny Yoro's red card has been handled by VAR John Brooks and referees' chief Howard Webb
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Senegal reinstated as Afcon 2025 winners by court ruling.
Ten months after the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final, Senegal are reinstated as champions following a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Bayern hold 'constructive' talks over Musiala's health.
Bayern Munich are only focused on getting Jamal Musiala back from injury and not interested in the comments made regarding his contract, the club's sporting director Max Eberl insists.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Man Utd target Collins - Wednesday's gossip.
Manchester United target Brentford defender Nathan Collins, Bournemouth price forward Eli Junior Kroupi at £100m and Liverpool close in on new Rio Ngumoha contract.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Síguenos para más noticias del fútbol.

videos.script:

Actualidad internacional.

Dead hippo to be honoured on football club tifo.
Major League Soccer side FC Cincinnati will honour Fiona, a hippo that recently died at the city's zoo, with a tifo display at their match with Nashville SC on Saturday.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Millwall face partial stadium closure after discriminatory chants.
Millwall must play a home game in front of a partially-closed stadium as punishment for fans' discriminatory chants.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

The youngest Premier League goalscorers this season.
After the stellar performances of Liverpool's Rio Ngumoha and Tottenham's Luca Williams-Barnett, BBC Sport looks at the youngest players to score in the Premier League this season.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Janelt scores stunner as Brentford beat 10-man Everton.
Watch highlights as Brentford earn a comfortable 3-0 win against 10-man Everton in the Premier League, including a great goal by Vitaly Janelt.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Moyes questions Tarkowski red in Brentford loss.
Everton manager David Moyes questions whether the force of James Tarkowski's challenge was taken into consideration, after the defender was shown a red card in his side's 4-0 loss by Brentford.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

videos.title: Últimas noticias del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Últimas noticias del fútbol.

Andrews praises 'versatile' Lewis-Potter.
Brentford manager Keith Andrews praises the performance of Keane Lewis-Potter, who scored twice in his side's 4-0 win against Everton.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Ngumoha stars as Liverpool thrash 10-man Man Utd.
Mauricio Pochettino's reign as Manchester United head coach begins in desperate fashion as his team are thrashed by rivals Liverpool to remain in the Premier League relegation zone.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Yoro red card overturned, but refs' chief Webb backs decision.
Manchester United defender Leny Yoro is clear to face Brentford on Saturday as his red card at Anfield is overturned.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Klopp advice and Iraola confidence boosts Wirtz.
Florian Wirtz opens up on why it's the best he has felt since joining Liverpool.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Non-league player injured falling down badger hole.
Cav Miley missed Chelmsford City's draw with Walton and Hersham after spraining an ankle falling down a badger hole.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
